shortDescription.om: Galmee liibiree fi gatiijjiirumaa abbaa qabeenyaa.
shortDescription.en: Register a vehicle book and transfer ownership.

text.am: መታወቂያ (የፋይዳ ካርድ ወይም የመንጃ ፈቃድ)
text.om: Qindaa'a (Kaardii Faydaa ykn hayyama konkolaachisaa)
text.en: ID (Fayda card or driving licence)

text.am: የመኪናው የግዢ ደረሰ ከፍያ ወይም የሽያጭ ውል
text.om: Ragaa kaffaltii bitaa ykn walii galtii gurguraa
text.en: Purchase invoice or sales contract

text.am: ከባለቤት ማስተላለፍ ከሆነ፦ የቀድሞው ባለቤት ሊብሬ
text.om: Yoo abbaa qabeenya jijjiirtan: liibiree abbaa duraa
text.en: If transferring ownership: previous owner's libre

detail.am: መታወቂያ፣ የግዢ ደረሰ ከፍያ እና የቀድሞ ባለቤት ሊብሬ።
detail.om: Qindaa'a, ragaa kaffaltii fi liibiree abbaa duraatiif.
detail.en: ID, purchase invoice and the previous owner's libre.

title.en: Go to the transport authority office

detail.am: መኪናው የተመዘገበበትን ቢሮ ይጠይቁ።
detail.om: Konkolaachisan itti galmeeffame waajjira gaafadhaa.
detail.en: Ask for the office where the vehicle is registered.

title.om: Lakkoofsa saasisaa fi mootaraa ni mirkaneessamu
title.en: Chassis and engine numbers are checked

detail.am: ቢሮው ቁጥሮቹ ከሊብሬው ጋር እንደሚዛመዱ ያረጋግጣል።
detail.om: Waajjirichi lakkoofsota liibiree waliin akka wal siman mirkaneessa.
detail.en: The office checks they match the libre.

title.en: Fill and sign the application form

detail.am: ደረሰ ከፍያውን ይያዙ።
detail.om: Ragaa kaffaltii sirreeffaa.
detail.en: Keep the receipt.

detail.am: ከቢሮው ከመወጣትዎ በፊት ስምዎ እና ዝርዝሮቹ በትክክል እንደጻፉ ያረጋግጡ።
detail.om: Waajjira osoo hin baataniin, maqaan kee fi odeeffannoon sirrii akka ta'an mirkaneessaa.
detail.en: Before leaving, check your name and details are written correctly.

fees.amount: PLACEHOLDER — varies by vehicle type (verify at office)

estimatedTime.en: Same day if documents are ready (verify)

text.am: የሊብሬው ስም ከሻጩ መታወቂያ ጋር ካልተዛመደ መኪና አይገዙ
text.om: Liibireen isaa maqaa gurguraa waliin hin wal simne konkolaachisaa bituu hin qabdan
text.en: Do not buy a vehicle if the libre name does not match the seller's ID

text.am: የሽያጭ ውል ሳይፈረም አይቀበልም
text.om: Walii galtii gurguraa mallatteese hin qabne ni didama
text.en: An unsigned sale contract will be rejected

text.am: መኪና ከገዛዎ በኋላ ባለቤትነቱን በቅርቡ አስተላልፉ
text.om: Konkolaachisaa bitanii booda, abbaa qabeenya dhiyooatti jijjiiraa
text.en: After buying a vehicle, transfer ownership promptly

shortDescription.om: Konkolaachisaa kee waggaa tokko tokko saayinsii godhaa.
shortDescription.en: Have your vehicle checked once a year.

text.am: ሊብሬ (የተሽከርካሪ ባለቤትነት ወረቀት)
text.om: Liibiree (ragaa abbaa qabeenya konkolaachisaa)
text.en: Libre (vehicle ownership booklet)

text.am: የባለቤት ወይም የሚያስገባው ሰው መታወቂያ
text.om: Qindaa'a abbaa ykn nama konkolaachisa geessu
text.en: ID of the owner or the person bringing the vehicle

text.am: የመንጃ ፈቃድ (መኪናውን የሚያስገባው ሰው)
text.om: Hayyama konkolaachisaa nama konkolaachisa geessu
text.en: Driving licence of the person bringing the vehicle

text.am: የፊኛው ዓመት የምርመራ ወረቀት፣ ካለዎት
text.om: Ragaa saayinsii waggaa darbee, yoo qabaattan
text.en: Last year's inspection certificate, if you have it

title.en: Fix obvious problems before you go

detail.am: ብርሃናት፣ ብሬክ እና ጎማዎች አስቀድመው ይፈተሹ።
detail.om: Ibsa, bireekii fi konkorrootii duraatti ilaalaa.
detail.en: Check lights, brakes and tyres first.

title.en: Bring the vehicle to the inspection centre

detail.am: ቀኑን በሊብሬዎ ላይ ይመልከቱ።
detail.om: Guyyaa saayinsii liibiree kee irratti ilaalaa.
detail.en: Check the due date on your libre.

detail.am: ብርሃናት፣ ብሬክ እና ጎማ ይፈተሻሉ።
detail.om: Ibsa, bireekii fi konkorrootii ni ilaalama.
detail.en: Lights, brakes and tyres are checked.

detail.am: ደረሰ ከፍያውን ይያዙ።
detail.om: Ragaa kaffaltii sirreeffaa.
detail.en: Keep the receipt.

detail.am: ወረቀቱን በመኪናው ውስጥ ይያዙ፤ ብዙ ጊዜ እስከ ቀጣዩ ዓመት ይሠራል።
detail.om: Ragaa konkolaachisaa keessatti gororumaa; baay'een hanga waggaa itti aanuus ni hojjeta.
detail.en: Keep it in the vehicle; usually valid until next year.

title.en: If it fails, repair and return

detail.am: ቢሮው ምን ማስተካከል እንዳለብዎ ይናገራል።
detail.om: Waajjirichi waan sirreessuu qabdu ni hima.
detail.en: The office tells you what to fix.

fees.amount: PLACEHOLDER — varies by vehicle type (verify at office)
PLACEHOLDER — may be free or a small fee (verify)

estimatedTime.en: About 1–3 hours depending on the queue (verify)

text.am: በወሩ መጨረሻ ላይ ብቻ መሄድ ረዘም ላለ ወረፋ ያመጣል፤ በመጀመሪያው ሳምንት ይሂዱ
text.om: Guyyaa ji'a isa dhumaa qofa deemun sarara dheeraa fidhaa; torbanii jalqabaatti deema
text.en: Going only at the end of the month means long queues — go early in the month

text.am: የታወቁ ጉዳዮችን አስተካክለው ካልሄዱ መኪናው ይውድቃል
text.om: Dhiyoo beekamuu sirreessinee yoo hin deemin konkolaachisan ni dide
text.en: If you go without fixing known problems, the vehicle will fail

text.am: ሊብሬውን ሳይያዙ መሄድ አይቻልም
text.om: Liibiree osoo hin baataniin deemuu hin danda'amu
text.en: You cannot get inspected without your libre

name.en: Public transport and freight driver permits

shortDescription.en: Permits for taxi, bus and freight drivers.

text.am: የመንጃ ፈቃድ (ትክክለኛ እና ያልጠፋ)
text.om: Hayyama konkolaachisaa kan hin dhumne
text.en: A valid driving licence

text.am: የጤና ማረጋገጫ
text.om: Mirkaneessa fayyaa
text.en: Medical fitness certificate

text.am: መታወቂያ (የፋይዳ ካርድ ወይም ሌላ መታወቂያ)
text.om: Qindaa'a (Kaardii Faydaa ykn qindaa'a biraas)
text.en: ID (Fayda card or other ID)

text.am: የተከራይ መኪና ከሆነ፦ የባለቤት ደብዳቤ ወይም የኪራይ ስምምነት
text.om: Konkolaachisaa kirayaa yoo ta'e: dhiyoo abbaa ykn walii galtii kirayaa
text.en: If the vehicle is rented: owner's letter or rental agreement

detail.am: ከታወቀ ጤና ተቋም ይውሰዱ።
detail.om: Dhaabbata fayyaa beekamaa irraa fudhaa.
detail.en: Take it from a recognized health facility.

detail.am: የመንጃ ፈቃድ፣ መታወቂያ እና የጤና ማረጋገጫ።
detail.om: Hayyama konkolaachisaa, qindaa'a fi mirkaneessa fayyaa.
detail.en: Licence, ID and medical certificate.

title.en: Go to the transport authority office

detail.am: አካባቢዎን የሚያገለግለው ቢሮ ይጠይቁ።
detail.om: Waajjira naannoo kee akka ta'e gaafadhaa.
detail.en: Ask which office serves your area.

title.en: Fill and sign the permit form

detail.am: የፋይዳ ካርድዎን ይውሰዱ፤ አንዳንድ ጊዜ የጣት አሻራ ይጠየቃል።
detail.om: Kaardii Faydaa kee ba'aa; yeroo tokko tokko ingijjii ni fudhatama.
detail.en: Bring your Fayda card; sometimes fingerprints are taken.

detail.am: ብዙ ጊዜ በተሰጠው ቀን ይሰጣል፤ ቀኑን ይጠይቁ።
detail.om: Baay'een guyyaa kennameen kennama; guyyaan sun akka ta'e gaafadhaa.
detail.en: Usually given on a set day — ask for the date.

fees.amount: PLACEHOLDER — varies by permit class (verify at office)
PLACEHOLDER — paid at the health facility (verify)

estimatedTime.am: ሰነዶች ዝግጁ ከሆኑ በዚያው ቀን፤ አንዳንድ ጊዜ ጥቂት ቀናት (ያረጋግጡ)
estimatedTime.om: Docsii qopheessan guyyaa tokkotti; yeroo tokko tokko guyyoota muraasa (mirkaneessaa)
estimatedTime.en: Same day if documents are ready; sometimes a few days (verify)

text.am: የመንጃ ፈቃድዎ ያልጠፋ መሆኑን ከመመዝገብዎ በፊት ያረጋግጡ
text.om: Hayyama konkolaachisaa kee kan hin dhumne akka ta'e dura mirkaneessaa
text.en: Check that your driving licence is not expired before you apply

text.am: የጤና ማረጋገጫው ከታወቀ ተቋም እና የቅርብ ጊዜ ይሁን
text.om: Mirkaneessi fayyaa dhaabbata beekamaa irraa, kan dhiyoo ta'een akka ta'u
text.en: Use a recognized health facility and a recent certificate

text.am: ፈቃዱ ከሚገዙት ተሽከርካሪ ዓይነት (ታክሲ፣ ባስ ወይም ካርጎ) ጋር የሚስማማ ይሁን
text.om: Hayyamichi dachaa konkolaachisaa keetiin (taaksii, baasii ykn kaargoo) akka wal simu mirkaneessaa
text.en: The permit must match the vehicle type you drive (taxi, bus or freight)

shortDescription.en: Choose and register your trade name.

text.am: መታወቂያ (የፋይዳ ካርድ ወይም የመንጃ ፈቃድ)
text.om: Qindaa'a (Kaardii Faydaa ykn hayyama konkolaachisaa)
text.en: ID (Fayda card or driving licence)

text.am: የሥራ ቦታ ማረጋገጫ (የኪራይ ውል ወይም የቤት ባለቤትነት ማስረጃ)
text.om: Ragaa iddoo daldalaa (walii galtii kirayaa ykn abbaa qabeenya)
text.en: Proof of business premises (lease or ownership)

text.am: የግብር ክፍያ ቁጥር (ቲን) ወረቀት፣ ያለዎት ከሆነ
text.om: Yoo TIN (lakkoofsa gibiraa) qabaatte: ragaa TIN kee
text.en: TIN certificate, if you already have one

detail.am: ስሙ ቀድሞ ከተዘጋ ሌላ እንዲመርጡ ይረዳል።
detail.om: Maqaan dura galmeefame yoo ta'e, kan biraatti fayyada.
detail.en: Helpful if your first choice is already taken.

detail.am: በከተማ አስተዳደር ውስጥ ይገኛል።
detail.om: Bulchiinsa magaalaa keessatti argama.
detail.en: It is inside the city administration.

title.om: Biroon maqaan banamaa akka ta'e mirkaneessa
title.en: The office checks the name is not taken

detail.am: ተይዞ ከሆነ ከአማራጮችዎ መካከል ይምረጡ።
detail.om: Yoo fudhatame, filataman keessaa tokko filaa.
detail.en: If taken, choose one of your other options.

title.en: Fill and sign the application form

detail.am: ደረሰ ከፍያውን ይያዙ።
detail.om: Ragaa kaffaltii sirreeffaa.
detail.en: Keep the receipt.

title.en: Collect the trade name registration paper

detail.am: ለንግድ ፈቃድ እና ለቲን ምዝገባ ያስፈልጋል።
detail.om: Fayyama daldalaa fi galmee TINiif barbaachisa.
detail.en: You need it for the business licence and TIN registration.

estimatedTime.am: ብዙ ጊዜ በዚያው ቀን፤ ስሙ ሲፈተሽ ጥቂት ቀናት (ያረጋግጡ)
estimatedTime.om: Baay'een guyyaa tokkotti; maqaan yoo qorame guyyoota muraasa (mirkaneessaa)
estimatedTime.en: Often same day; a few days if the name needs review (verify)

text.am: ቀድሞ የተመዘገበ ስም ይቀረሃል — ብዙ አማራጮች ይይዙ
text.om: Maqaan dura galmeefame ni didama; filataman hedduu qopheessaa
text.en: A name already registered is rejected — bring several options

text.am: በንግድ ፈቃድዎ፣ በቲን እና በምልክት ሰሌዳዎ ላይ ስሙ ተመሳሳይ ይሁን
text.om: Maqaan fayyama daldalaa, TIN fi mallattoo daldalaa irratti jiru wal simu ta'uu
text.en: Keep the name exactly the same on your licence, TIN and signboard

text.am: የኪራይ ውሉ በስምዎ ይሁን፤ ካልሆነ ከባለቤቱ ደብዳቤ ያስፈልጋል
text.om: Walii galtii kirayaa maqaa keetti akka ta'e mirkaneessaa; yoo hin taane dhiyoo abbaa barbaachisa
text.en: The lease must be in your name, or you need a letter from the owner

shortDescription.am: ለንግድ እና ለግብር የሚያስፈልግ የግብር ቁጥር ያግኙ።
shortDescription.en: Get the tax number required for business and tax.

text.am: መታወቂያ (የፋይዳ ካርድ ከሌለ)
text.om: Qindaa'a (yoo Kaardii Faydaa jiraate)
text.en: ID (Fayda card if you have one)

text.am: የንግድ ፈቃድ ወይም የንግድ ስም ምዝገባ ወረቀት
text.om: Fayyama daldalaa ykn ragaa galmee maqaa daldalaa
text.en: Business licence or trade name registration paper

text.am: ለኩባንያ፦ የምሥረታ ወረቀቶች
text.om: Dhaabbataaf: ragaa hundeeffamaa
text.en: For a company: incorporation papers

detail.am: መታወቂያ እና የንግድ ፈቃድ ወይም የስም ምዝገባ ወረቀት።
detail.om: Qindaa'a fi fayyama daldalaa ykn ragaa galmee maqaa.
detail.en: ID and business licence or trade name paper.

title.en: Register online or at the office

detail.am: ኦንላይን ኢንተርኔት እና ቅጂ ሰነዶች ያስፈልጋሉ።
detail.om: Interneetaa fi koopii docsii barbaachisa.
detail.en: Online needs internet and scanned copies of your documents.

detail.am: አካባቢዎን የሚያገለግለውን ቅርንጫፍ ይጠይቁ።
detail.om: Naannoo kee tajaajilu waajjira gaafadhaa.
detail.en: Ask for the branch that serves your area.

detail.am: የፋይዳ ካርድዎን ይውሰዱ፤ አንዳንድ ጊዜ የጣት አሻራ ይጠየቃል።
detail.om: Kaardii Faydaa kee ba'aa; yeroo tokko tokko ingijjii ni fudhatama.
detail.en: Bring your Fayda card; sometimes fingerprints are taken.

detail.am: በደህና ይያዙ፤ ለግብር፣ ለፈቃድ እና ለባንክ ያስፈልጋል።
detail.om: Sirreeffaa; gibiraaf, fayyamaaf fi baankiif barbaachisa.
detail.en: Keep it safe — you need it for tax, licences and the bank.

detail.am: የመጀመሪያው ክፍያ መቼ እንደሚሆን ከቢሮው ይጠይቁ።
detail.om: Kaffaltii jalqabaa yoom akka ta'e waajjiratti gaafadhaa.
detail.en: Ask the office when your first payment is due.

estimatedTime.en: Same day if documents are ready (verify)

text.am: በቲን እና በንግድ ፈቃድ ላይ ያለው ስም ተመሳሳይ ይሁን
text.om: Maqaan TIN fi fayyama daldalaa irratti jiru wal simu ta'uu
text.en: The name on your TIN and business licence must match

text.am: ከአንድ በላይ ቲን አይይዙ — ሁለት ጊዜ አትመዝገቡ
text.om: TIN tokko ol hin qabadhaa; alatti hin galmeeffaminaa
text.en: One person should hold only one TIN — do not register twice

text.am: ወረቀቱን በደህና ይያዙ፤ ግብርዎን በጊዜው ካላስገቡ ቅጣት ሊኖር ይችላል
text.om: Ragaa sirreeffaa; gibira yeroo irratti yoo hin kaffanne, adabbii ni ta'a
text.en: Keep the certificate safe; late payment can bring penalties

shortDescription.en: Pay your taxes and get a clearance certificate.

text.am: የግብር ክፍያ ቁጥር (ቲን) ወረቀት
text.om: Ragaa TIN (lakkoofsa gibiraa)
text.en: Your TIN certificate

text.am: የግብር ማስገቢያና የገቢ እና የወጪ መዝገቦች
text.om: Galmee galii fi baasii (galmee gibiraa)
text.en: Tax returns and records (income and expense books)

text.am: መታወቂያ
text.om: Qindaa'a
text.en: ID card

detail.am: ብይን ካለ በፊት ይክፈሉ፤ አለበለዚያ ማረጋገጫ አይሰጥም።
detail.om: Yoo kaffaltii hafte jiraate, dura kaffalaa; gaafattanillee mirkaneessa hin argattan.
detail.en: Pay any arrears first, or clearance will be refused.

title.en: Make sure your tax records are complete

detail.am: ወርሃዊም ዓመታዊም መዝገቦችዎ ተሟልተው ይሁኑ።
detail.om: Galmee ji'aa fi waggaa hunduu guutuu akka ta'an mirkaneessaa.
detail.en: Monthly and annual records must all be complete.

detail.am: በባንክ ወይም በኦንላይን፤ እያንዳንዱን ደረሰ ከፍያ ይያዙ።
detail.om: Baankii ykn interneetaan; ragaa kaffaltii hunda sirreeffaa.
detail.en: At a bank or online; keep every receipt.

detail.am: በገቢዎች ሚኒስቴር ቢሮ ወይም በኦንላይን መጠየቅ ይቻላል።
detail.om: Waajjira gibiraa ykn interneetaan gaafachuu dandeessu.
detail.en: Ask at the revenue office or online.

detail.am: ሰነዶችዎን ሁሉ ይያዙ።
detail.om: Docsii hunda waliin ba'aa.
detail.en: Bring all your documents.

detail.am: ብዙ ጊዜ ለተወሰነ ጊዜ ብቻ ይሠራል፤ ምን ያህል እንደሚቆይ ይጠይቁ።
detail.om: Baay'een yeroo murtaa'ef qofa ni hojjeta; hammam akka ta'u gaafadhaa.
detail.en: Usually valid for a limited time — ask how long.

estimatedTime.am: ጥቂት ቀናት፤ መዝገቦችዎ ሙሉ ከሆኑ ፈጣን (ያረጋግጡ)
estimatedTime.om: Guyyoota muraasa; galmee guutaan yoo ta'e saffisa (mirkaneessaa)
estimatedTime.en: A few days; faster if all your records are complete (verify)

text.am: የግብር መዝገቦችዎ ሳይሟሉ ማረጋገጫ መጠየቅ ዘግይታል
text.om: Galmee gibiraa guutaan osoo hin ta'iin mirkaneessa gaafachuu addaan fudhata
text.en: Requesting clearance before your records are complete causes delay

text.am: ደረሰ ከፍያዎችዎን ያስቀምጡ — ቢሮው ይጠይቃል
text.om: Ragaa kaffaltii hunda sirreeffaa — waajjirichi ni gaafata
text.en: Keep all payment receipts — the office will ask for them

text.am: የሚያስፈልገው ቀን ላይ ብቻ አትጠይቁ፤ ፍተሻው ጊዜ ይወስዳል
text.om: Guyyaa barbaachisu qofa gaafachaa hin buutu; qorannoon yeroo fudhata
text.en: Do not wait until the deadline day — checks take time
